description.value: Burnaby Art Gallery is the only public art museum in Canada dedicated exclusively to collecting works of art on paper, representing artists of diverse backgrounds and practices. It is housed in a beautifully restored arts and crafts mansion on the shores of Deer Lake, making it a scenic destination in its own right. Admission is always free, and the gallery offers rotating exhibitions, curator talks, workshops, and school programs throughout the year.
